Discover refined luxury in this exceptional 4-bedroom villa in District One Villas, offering an expansive plot, elegant interiors, and a prime location just moments from the community's premium amenities. Vacant and ready for immediate occupancy, this residence is ideal for families seeking privacy, space, and an exclusive lifestyle.

4 Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms
Large Plot
Vacant and Ready to Move In
Spacious Living & Dining Areas
Modern Closed Kitchen with Premium Finishes
En-suite Bedrooms
Built-in Wardrobes
Maid's Room
Private Garden
Covered Parking

Community Amenities:

Crystal Lagoon and Sandy Beaches
Cycling and Jogging Tracks
Parks and Green Open Spaces
Children's Play Areas
24/7 Gated Security
Retail and Dining Options
Easy Access to Downtown Dubai and Major Highways

Located in the prestigious District One community, this villa offers the perfect blend of luxury, tranquility, and convenience. Surrounded by lush landscapes and world-class amenities, residents enjoy an exclusive lifestyle while remaining just minutes from Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Meydan.
